COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET

Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.

nding Legal Matters
10A.
A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ESTABLISHING A RESOURCE ADEQUACY PROGRAM FOR THE CITY OF CERRITOS ELECTRIC UTILITY IN FURTHERANCE OF RESOLUTION NO. 2006-1 AND AUTHORIZING THE TAKING OF CERTAIN OTHER ACTION IN CONNECTION THEREWITH
11.
Public Works Activities
11A.
A Utility Agreement with the California Department of Transportation establishing the liability for the costs related to the relocation of a water main on Valley View Avenue in connection with the I-5 Corridor Improvement Project within the City of Cerritos.
11B.
Award of contract for the design of a Valley View Avenue water utility relocation project in connection with the I-5 corridor improvement project within the City of Cerritos.
12.
New and Old Business
12A.
A report on designs and materials for a photo backdrop for the Cerritos City Council Chambers.
12B.
A proposal to set a minimum valuation for the placement of public artwork as required by Chapter 22.94 of the Cerritos Municipal Code, relating to the Art in Public Places Program.
12C.
The withdrawal of the low bidder from Bid No. 1103-11, Printing of the 2011 Cerritos Community Calendar and re-award of the contract to the next lowest bidder.
12D.
A request for a City estoppel certificate in connection with refinancing of a corporate credit facility by Sunstone Hotel Partnership, LLC, the parent of Sunstone Center Court, LLC, owner of the Sheraton Cerritos Hotel, and inclusion of Sunstone Center Court, LLC, as a guarantor of that credit facility.
13.

13A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
13B.
